menuconfig ZBUS
	bool "Zbus support"
	depends on MULTITHREADING
	help
	  Enables support for Zephyr message bus.

if ZBUS

config ZBUS_CHANNELS_SYS_INIT_PRIORITY
	int "The init priority of the channels' observation initialization"
	default 5
	help
	  Execution priority of the sys_init used to organize the channels' observations
	  at boot time.

config ZBUS_CHANNEL_NAME
	bool "Channel name field"
	help
	  Enable this configuration to allow the channel to have a string containing
	  its name in its metadata.

config ZBUS_CHANNEL_ID
	bool "Channel numeric identifier"
	help
	  Enable this configuration to allow channels to carry numeric identifiers
	  and the retrieval of channel reference for an identifier.

config ZBUS_OBSERVER_NAME
	bool "Observer name field"
	help
	  Enable this configuration to allow the observer to have a string containing
	  its name in its metadata.

config ZBUS_MSG_SUBSCRIBER
	bool "Message subscribers will receive the message body sequentially."
	select NET_BUF
	help
	  Enabling this config the programmer will be able to use message subscribers via
	  ZBUS_MSG_SUBSCRIBER_DEFINE instead of ZBUS_SUBSCRIBER_DEFINE. Message subscribers
	  differ from subscribers by receiving the copy of the message on in a FIFO queue
	  instead of only the channel reference notification on a message queue.

if ZBUS_MSG_SUBSCRIBER

choice ZBUS_MSG_SUBSCRIBER_BUF_ALLOC
	prompt "Method used by ZBus to buffer allocation inside the publishers."
	default ZBUS_MSG_SUBSCRIBER_BUF_ALLOC_DYNAMIC

config ZBUS_MSG_SUBSCRIBER_BUF_ALLOC_DYNAMIC
	bool "It causes the use of heap to allocate msg_subscribers buffer data."
	select HEAP_MEM_POOL_IGNORE_MIN
	help
	  This creates a variable dependency on the heap in trade of dynamic memory utilization
	  efficacy.

config ZBUS_MSG_SUBSCRIBER_BUF_ALLOC_STATIC
	bool "It uses a fixed message data slice on the stack to allocate notifications"
	help
	  Beware the channel will fail on publishing messages bigger than the configured
	  CONFIG_ZBUS_MSG_SUBSCRIBER_NET_BUF_STATIC_DATA_SIZE.

endchoice

config ZBUS_MSG_SUBSCRIBER_NET_BUF_POOL_ISOLATION
	bool "Indicate the developer wants to create the net_buf pool by page to avoid interference"
	depends on ZBUS_MSG_SUBSCRIBER
	help
	  Enable this configuration to allow the developer to create the net_buf pool for the
	  channel by themselves.

config ZBUS_MSG_SUBSCRIBER_NET_BUF_POOL_SIZE
	int "The count of net_buf available to be used simultaneously."
	default 16
	depends on ZBUS_MSG_SUBSCRIBER
	help
	  Simultaneously used net_buf the dynamic pool will support.

config ZBUS_MSG_SUBSCRIBER_NET_BUF_STATIC_DATA_SIZE
	int "The maximum size of a message chart which can be sent to a msg_subscriber"
	depends on ZBUS_MSG_SUBSCRIBER_BUF_ALLOC_STATIC
	default 0
	help
	  Always define this manually up to the maximum size of the biggest message going to
	  be published to a MSG_SUBSCRIBER.

config HEAP_MEM_POOL_ADD_SIZE_ZBUS
	int "Number of bytes reserved for the ZBUS dynamic allocation inside the system heap."
	depends on ZBUS_MSG_SUBSCRIBER_BUF_ALLOC_DYNAMIC
	default 1024
	help
	  It reserves the specified amount of bytes to be used exclusively by the ZBUS subsystem.

endif # ZBUS_MSG_SUBSCRIBER

config ZBUS_RUNTIME_OBSERVERS
	bool "Runtime observers support."
	help
	  Enable the runtime observers registration, enable/disable, etc. dynamically.

config ZBUS_PRIORITY_BOOST
	bool "Zbus priority boost the Highest Locker Protocol."
	default y
	help
	  Zbus enables the Highest Locker Protocol that boosts the publishing thread priority based
	  on the highest priority of a channel's observers. It only elevates the publishing thread's
	  priority if there is at least one subscriber enabled and waiting on the channel. This reduces
	  the mutual exclusion lock time to the minimum and solves the priority inversion issue when
	  using the message bus with threads of different priorities.

module = ZBUS
module-str = zbus
source "subsys/logging/Kconfig.template.log_config"

endif # ZBUS
